mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and there are no exceptions to it. Connections use https everywhere, so no host is exempt, whether internal or external.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
